title: Mid-cycle Roadmap Pulse: Q2 focus, risks, and rapid escalation plan
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: produce a concise mid-cycle packet for the March QBR and prep an escalation playbook for three at-risk Q2 initiatives (Dedicated autoscale, KV cache persistence, and Private deploy upgrade flow). Deliverables: 1) 6-slide exec summary highlighting scope, momentum, and ask; 2) Risk register with mitigations and owners; 3) Rapid escalation runbook that triggers at 3 risk thresholds. Background: After sprint reviews in early March, several cross-functional dependencies surfaced (infra capacity for Dedicated autoscale, a compatibility regression in the runtime affecting KV cache durability, and a delayed security review for on-prem upgrade automation). This ticket consolidates inputs from Eng, Design, and Security and produces the QBR-ready packet and a step-by-step escalation plan for on-call and GTM leads.
acceptance_criteria: A single PDF exec packet (<=6 slides) that can be shared with leadership
Risk register covering likelihood, impact, owner, mitigation, and contingency for each at-risk initiative
Escalation playbook with concrete triggers, communication templates, and rollback/fallback options
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng leads, Security, and Revenue Ops
Presentation rehearsal scheduled with PM and VP of Product before QBR
updates: 2026-03-10: Ticket created after cross-team sync; initial risk list captured from ENG and Security.
2026-03-11: Eng provided updated latency profiles for Dedicated autoscale (link to internal dashboard). Identified dependency on new kernel-selection heuristic rollout (ENG-34122).
2026-03-12: Design delivered mockups for a condensed exec slide; suggested heatmap visualization for initiative risk. Assigned DES-2145 for final slide art.
2026-03-13: Security flagged on-prem upgrade flow as 'review pending' — prerequisite for Private release; added mitigation: temporary opt-in gate and manual approval step.
2026-03-14: Draft packet assembled; requested VP review and scheduled rehearsal for 2026-03-18. Added contingency: enable fallback model routing to hosted catalog if dedicated capacity degrades.
next_steps: Lock final slide deck and export PDF by 2026-03-17
Run 30-minute rehearsal on 2026-03-18 with talking points and Q/A prep
Publish escalation playbook to runbook repo and notify on-call rotations
notes_for_execs: Ask: approve two tactical invests for Q2 contingency -- (1) 120k monthly reserved burst capacity for Dedicated to cover 95th percentile load spikes during rollout, (2) a 2-week security contractor review window to unblock on-prem automation. Impact: reduces probability of degraded SLAs during rollout from 'likely' to 'low' for customer-facing tenants.
communication_plan: Notify stakeholders via #roadmap-ops and send email digest to execs at 24h and 2h before QBR. Post-QBR: publish one-page decision log and action items in Confluence and tag relevant owners. Templates included in artifacts.
